rules.name: Strip Leading Enumeration Markers
rules.description: Removes leading formatting artifacts like (i), (ii), 1., 2), (a) from claim text without corrupting modal verbs
rules.author: PIPELINE_GOVERNANCE

rules.name: Normalize Excess Whitespace and Linebreaks
rules.description: Collapses multi-space runs and formatting linebreaks into single spaces
rules.author: PIPELINE_GOVERNANCE

rules.name: Strip Trailing Editorial Bracket Notes
rules.description: Removes trailing page or editorial bracket markers like [Page 8] from text
rules.author: PIPELINE_GOVERNANCE
